occupancy._comment: Violation = more than max_occupancy tracked persons present for min_violation_frames consecutive frames. Tune max_occupancy per room type (e.g. 1 for a single-patient room, higher for a ward).

fall_detection._comment: STUB -- disabled until a pose-estimation model (e.g. YOLOv8-Pose) is available. Object-detection classes alone (just 'person') can't reliably distinguish standing from fallen; this needs keypoint geometry, not a bbox class. See solutions/healthcare_monitoring/logic.py's check_falls() for the intended plug-in point.
